meaning: effect; result (of a measure or effort)

senses.en: effect; result (of a measure or effort)

note: Collocations: 有成效, 见成效, 成效显著.

examples.zh: 这个办法很有成效。
examples.en: This method is very effective.

examples.zh: 工作三个月后，才看到成效。
examples.en: We only saw results after three months of work.

examples.zh: 我觉得这次培训没什么成效。
examples.en: I don't think this training achieved much.

meaning: performance; quality of function (of a machine or product)

senses.en: performance; quality of function (of a machine or product)

examples.zh: 这台电脑的性能很好。
examples.en: This computer performs very well.

examples.zh: 买手机时，我最重视性能。
examples.en: When buying a phone, I care most about performance.

examples.zh: 这辆车的性能怎么样？
examples.en: How does this car perform?

meaning: helpless; having no choice; (conj.) but unfortunately

senses.en: helpless; having no choice; (conj.) but unfortunately

note: As a conjunction it starts the clause giving the obstacle, written style.

examples.zh: 他很想去，无奈没有时间。
examples.en: He really wanted to go, but sadly had no time.

examples.zh: 我也很无奈，公司的规定就是这样。
examples.en: I feel helpless too. That is just the company's rule.

examples.zh: 她无奈地笑了笑。
examples.en: She smiled helplessly.

meaning: to generate; to be formed; to come into being

senses.en: to generate; to be formed; to come into being

note: Common with software: 自动生成 means automatically generated.

examples.zh: 系统会自动生成一个号码。
examples.en: The system will automatically generate a number.

examples.zh: 这个软件能生成报告。
examples.en: This software can generate reports.

examples.zh: 雨是怎么生成的？
examples.en: How is rain formed?

meaning: to mobilize; to urge people to take part

senses.en: to mobilize; to urge people to take part

examples.zh: 学校动员学生参加活动。
examples.en: The school urged students to join the activity.

examples.zh: 公司开了一次动员会。
examples.en: The company held a mobilization meeting.

examples.zh: 他被朋友动员去跑步了。
examples.en: His friend talked him into going running.

meaning: therefore; as a result

senses.en: therefore; as a result

note: Written/formal; the result clause follows the cause clause.

examples.zh: 他很努力，因而进步很快。
examples.en: He works hard, and so he is making fast progress.

examples.zh: 路上堵车，因而我们迟到了。
examples.en: There was a traffic jam, so we were late.

examples.zh: 天气变冷了，因而感冒的人多了。
examples.en: The weather turned cold, so more people caught colds.

meaning: total number; sum

senses.en: total number; sum

examples.zh: 参加的人总数是一百。
examples.en: The total number of participants is one hundred.

examples.zh: 你知道学生的总数吗？
examples.en: Do you know the total number of students?

examples.zh: 报名总数已经超过去年了。
examples.en: The total number of sign-ups has already passed last year's.

meaning: to circulate (air, goods, money); circulation

senses.en: to circulate (air, goods, money); circulation

examples.zh: 房间要让空气流通。
examples.en: A room needs air to circulate.

examples.zh: 这种钱在国外不流通。
examples.en: This kind of money isn't used abroad.

examples.zh: 商品流通快，价格就稳定。
examples.en: When goods circulate quickly, prices stay stable.

meaning: mountain area; mountainous region

senses.en: mountain area; mountainous region

examples.zh: 他在山区当老师。
examples.en: He works as a teacher in a mountain area.

examples.zh: 山区的交通不方便。
examples.en: Transport in mountain areas is not convenient.

examples.zh: 这个山区空气很好。
examples.en: The air in this mountain area is very good.

meaning: volume; size (of space an object takes up)

senses.en: volume; size (of space an object takes up)

examples.zh: 这个箱子的体积太大，放不进车里。
examples.en: This box is too bulky to fit in the car.

examples.zh: 手机的体积越来越小。
examples.en: Phones keep getting smaller.

examples.zh: 请问这个盒子的体积是多少？
examples.en: Excuse me, what is the volume of this box?

meaning: hardware

senses.en: hardware

note: Opposite: 软件. Also figurative: school or hospital facilities.

examples.zh: 这台电脑的硬件很新。
examples.en: This computer's hardware is very new.

examples.zh: 软件没问题，是硬件坏了。
examples.en: The software is fine. The hardware is broken.

examples.zh: 学校的硬件条件越来越好。
examples.en: The school's facilities keep getting better.

meaning: on the shore; on the bank

senses.en: on the shore; on the bank

examples.zh: 孩子都在岸上等我们。
examples.en: The children are all waiting for us on the shore.

examples.zh: 大家都在岸上看比赛。
examples.en: Everyone is watching the race from the bank.

examples.zh: 船到了，请到岸上休息。
examples.en: The boat has arrived. Please rest on shore.

meaning: to lead (a group or team)

senses.en: to lead (a group or team)

note: Formal; the leader heads a delegation, team or army.

examples.zh: 王老师率领学生去北京参加比赛。
examples.en: Teacher Wang led the students to Beijing for a competition.

examples.zh: 他率领一个小组完成了任务。
examples.en: He led a group to complete the task.

examples.zh: 经理率领大家参观了工厂。
examples.en: The manager led everyone on a visit to the factory.

meaning: long-lived; having a long life

senses.en: long-lived; having a long life

note: Birthday wish: 祝您健康长寿.

examples.zh: 祝您健康长寿！
examples.en: Wishing you good health and a long life!

examples.zh: 爷爷很长寿，九十岁还很健康。
examples.en: Grandpa has lived long and is still healthy at ninety.

examples.zh: 吃得简单，也许能长寿。
examples.en: Eating simply may help you live longer.

meaning: to take as the main part; mainly based on

senses.en: to take as the main part; mainly based on

note: Pattern 以……为主 (X is the main part), e.g. 以面包为主.

examples.zh: 我早饭吃面包为主。
examples.en: My breakfast is mainly bread.

examples.zh: 这家店做南方菜为主。
examples.en: This restaurant mainly serves southern dishes.

examples.zh: 学汉语，练习要为主，不要只看书。
examples.en: When learning Chinese, practice should come first, not just reading.

meaning: New Year's Eve (Chinese lunar calendar)

senses.en: New Year's Eve (Chinese lunar calendar)

examples.zh: 除夕晚上，全家一起吃饭。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve, the whole family eats together.

examples.zh: 你除夕回家吗？
examples.en: Are you going home for New Year's Eve?

examples.zh: 除夕那天，很多商店关门。
examples.en: Many shops are closed on New Year's Eve.

meaning: single; only one kind; lacking variety

senses.en: single; only one kind; lacking variety

examples.zh: 只吃单一的食物对身体不好。
examples.en: Eating only one kind of food is bad for your body.

examples.zh: 这家店的产品太单一了。
examples.en: This shop's products are too limited in variety.

examples.zh: 收入来源单一，风险就大。
examples.en: With a single source of income, the risk is high.

meaning: to output; to export (goods, data, signals)

senses.en: to output; to export (goods, data, signals)

examples.zh: 这个软件可以把文件输出成图片。
examples.en: This software can export the file as an image.

examples.zh: 我们国家向国外输出大量产品。
examples.en: Our country exports many products abroad.

examples.zh: 电脑没有输出声音，请检查。
examples.en: The computer isn't outputting sound. Please check it.

meaning: deposit (refundable)

senses.en: deposit (refundable)

note: Refundable security deposit; a down payment toward a price is 定金.

examples.zh: 租房子要交两个月的押金。
examples.en: Renting a flat requires a two-month deposit.

examples.zh: 走的时候，押金会还你。
examples.en: When you leave, the deposit will be returned to you.

examples.zh: 骑共享自行车要交押金吗？
examples.en: Do I need to pay a deposit to ride a shared bike?

meaning: plateau

senses.en: plateau

examples.zh: 他在高原上住了五年。
examples.en: He lived on the plateau for five years.

examples.zh: 去高原要注意休息。
examples.en: When you go to a plateau, take care to rest.

examples.zh: 这片高原夏天很凉快。
examples.en: This plateau is cool in summer.
